description: This file defines the UploadedFileInterface, an interface within the PSR-7 HTTP Message standard. It specifies the methods that any class implementing this interface must provide for handling uploaded files in an HTTP request, including retrieving a stream, moving the file, and accessing file metadata.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for an uploaded file, including methods to access the file's stream, move the file, and retrieve file metadata.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file, or throws an exception if unavailable or previously moved.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location. Throws exceptions if called multiple times or if an error occurs.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the upload error status, based on PHP's UPLOAD_ERR constants.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client, potentially untrusted.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client, potentially untrusted.
